profile.name: Dasun Praweena Jayasinghe
profile.headline: Software Engineering Undergraduate
profile.introduction: An aspiring software engineer at Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka. I turn curiosity into practical digital solutions, one thoughtful project at a time.
about: I'm Dasun Praweena Jayasinghe, a Software Engineering undergraduate at the Faculty of Computing, Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka.

I enjoy the process of turning a problem into something useful: understanding the need, exploring the design, and bringing it to life through code. Academic and collaborative projects are where I put those ideas into practice.
My goal is to grow into a thoughtful software engineer, contribute to a team, and keep learning the tools that help solve real-world problems.

projects.name: Student Marketplace
projects.short: A university-focused space for products, bike rentals, lost and found, and student services.
projects.problem: Students need a convenient way to discover products, rentals, lost items, and useful services within their university community.
projects.solution: A university marketplace that brings these needs into a shared digital space.

projects.name: ProFix
projects.short: A home service booking platform designed around finding help and arranging a service.
projects.problem: Finding and arranging a home service can involve disconnected searches and conversations.
projects.solution: A home service booking platform that connects service discovery with a clear booking experience.

projects.name: Supermarket Information System
projects.short: An academic information system using C# and MySQL to explore business data and application development.
projects.problem: Supermarket information needs to be organised and made accessible through a structured system.
projects.solution: A C# application supported by a MySQL database.

projects.name: Student Performance Analytics
projects.short: Exploring student performance through statistical analysis and presenting meaningful findings.
projects.problem: Student performance data needs to be examined carefully to understand relationships between variables.
projects.solution: Statistical analysis using SPSS, with results presented through clear summaries and visualisations.

projects.name: House Service Booking System
projects.short: A location-based service booking concept that helps people discover relevant home services.
projects.problem: People looking for home services need to find options relevant to their location.
projects.solution: A booking system with location-based service discovery.

projects.name: Rocket Landing Simulation
projects.short: A C# console application exploring control flow and the logic behind a simulated rocket landing.
projects.problem: A rocket landing scenario provides a practical way to explore programming decisions and simulation logic.
projects.solution: A console-based rocket landing simulation written in C#.

learningTopics.title: Linux & Ubuntu
learningTopics.summary: Getting comfortable with the command line and the foundations of a Linux environment.
learningTopics.goal: Practise a small system task using the terminal, file permissions, and helpful command documentation.

learningTopics.title: Docker
learningTopics.summary: Exploring how containers make applications easier to run in a consistent development environment.
learningTopics.goal: Containerise a small application and practise running it with ports and a development volume.

learningTopics.title: Flutter
learningTopics.summary: Learning the building blocks of mobile interfaces and application development with Flutter.
learningTopics.goal: Create a small mobile interface and understand how its screens and application logic fit together.

learningTopics.title: Cybersecurity
learningTopics.summary: Building an understanding of security fundamentals and how they relate to software development.
learningTopics.goal: Recognise common security risks and practise applying basic security thinking to an academic project.
